async def _validate_collection_access(collection_names: list[str], user, access_type: str = 'read') -> None:
    """
    Raise 403 if the user lacks access to any of the requested collections.
    Delegates to the shared filter_accessible_collections utility so the
    access rules stay in one place.
    """
    requested = set(collection_names)
    allowed = await filter_accessible_collections(requested, user, access_type=access_type)
    denied = requested - allowed
    if denied:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            detail=ERROR_MESSAGES.ACCESS_PROHIBITED,
        )

async def _validate_collection_access(collection_names: list[str], user, access_type: str = 'read') -> None:
    """
    Raise 403 if the user lacks access to any of the requested collections.
    Delegates to the shared filter_accessible_collections utility so the
    access rules stay in one place.
    """
    requested = set(collection_names)
    allowed = await filter_accessible_collections(requested, user, access_type=access_type)
    denied = requested - allowed
    if denied:
        raise HTTPException(

async def _validate_collection_access(collection_names: list[str], user, access_type: str = 'read') -> None:

This is bounded to the declared entry and supplied source; source discovery is not tested, and no deployment or repository-wide fact is inferred.

facts.statement: The declared entry is POST /process/text, implemented by process_text.
The handler binds the caller through get_verified_user.
The handler takes collection_name from the submitted form and, when supplied, validates that selected collection with write access.
A supplied collection name is sent to _validate_collection_access before document creation and the write call.
The shared access filter returns collection names immediately only for an admin; otherwise it evaluates the non-admin branches.

For a non-special collection that may be a knowledge-base ID, the shared filter adds it only when the user's requested access type is granted; if access fails, it allows the name only when no knowledge base exists with that ID.
The validator computes denied requested names and raises HTTP 403 when any selected name is not allowed.
The protected effect is saving a document containing the submitted content to the selected collection through save_docs_to_vector_db; this call occurs after validation.
The source path distinguishes the non-admin case from the admin bypass and applies the requested write access type to the selected collection.
